usefulness.rationale: Understanding is strong: the dossier establishes identity (born 8 May 1953, cardiothoracic surgeon), career (founded Narayana Hrudayalaya ~2000/2001, also RTIICS Kolkata), personal work (15,000+ operations, 1-2 surgeries/day six days a week), organisational scale (32 hospitals, 12% of India's heart surgery), recognition (Padma Shri 2004, Padma Bhushan 2012), views (NMC Bill, spirituality), and a recent 2024 Delhi High Court deepfake injunction. A reader clearly learns who he is and what he has done. RemainingQuestions is mid-range: claim statuses (claimed/supported/contested) signal evidentiary weight, but the dossier never states what it does not know, and it leaves unresolved internal conflicts unflagged — founding year 2000 vs 2001, and 21 vs 32 medical centres/hospitals — without noting the discrepancy. ConversationReadiness is high: role, current activities, organisational scale, public positions, and a live legal matter are all covered, sufficient to prepare for a meeting.
